Description: Humans become infected at the force of infection.
A fraction of infected humans develop clinical disease and are successfully treated.
A fraction of infected humans develop patent asymptomatic infection.
Successfully treated individuals clear infection and enter prophylactic protection.
Individuals who fail treatment eventually clear disease and become patent asymptomatic.
Patent asymptomatic infection progresses to sub-patent infection.
Sub-patent infection is eventually cleared and individuals return to full susceptibility.
Individuals return to susceptibility after prophylaxis wanes.
Mosquitoes become infected when taking an infectious bite from humans.
Latent mosquitoes become infectious to humans after the extrinsic incubation period.

Name: L
Description: Population force of infection determining human infection risk.

Name: w
Description: Determined by current level of anti-disease immunity.

Name: f_T
Description: Fixed probability that individuals with clinical disease receive effective treatment.

Name: r_T
Description: Rate at which successfully treated individuals enter prophylaxis.
Value: rate of entering prophylactic protection after treatment

Name: r_P
Description: Rate at which prophylaxis wanes and individuals return to susceptibility.

Name: r_D
Description: Rate at which untreated clinical disease resolves into patent asymptomatic infection.
Value: rate of clearing untreated clinical disease

Name: r_A
Description: Depends on anti-parasite immunity.
Value: rate of progression from patent asymptomatic infection to sub-patent infection

Name: r_U
Description: Rate at which sub-patent infection is cleared and susceptibility is restored.

Name: HBI
Description: Determines mosquito infectivity to humans together with biting rate.

Name: EIR
Description: Used to characterize transmission intensity and fit the model.
Unit: infectious bites per person per year

Name: SP
Description: Assumed first-line therapy before ACT introduction; drug half-life determines prophylaxis duration.

Name: ACT
Description: First-line treatment after introduction; also used in MSAT.

Name: DDT
Description: Used in IRS; assumed half-life of 6 months.

Name: LLIN
Description: Vector control intervention with protective efficacy that decays over time.

Name: RTS,S/AS01
Description: Assumed to reduce transmission from mosquitoes to people; efficacy half-life of 3 years.
